i17_observer_package.instructions: Which catalogue package should own the 14 merged K27 observer operations (the 15th method, sessionTokenForTest, is decided by the token-shape question)? The observer is an independent doubles-only witness whose normative scope forbids sharing anything executable with the adapter under test, while s3:: already owns the live-client object surface. Judge by which placement keeps the doubles-vs-live lane boundary legible to a generation-minded reader and cheapest to keep separate under the no-compat rule.

criteria.new_store_package: Create a new store:: package with a store::store_fault{layer, code} error, mirroring how I13 created db:: + db::db_fault for the K22/K23 doubles: 14 owner-first ops (open_prefix/receipt/close_prefix/open_session/close_session/put/settle_write/pending/get/delete/compare_bytes/list/seal_cleanup/shared_digest), fact records, void results where the service returns void, bytes::buffer for put/get/compare_bytes, option::value<str> for the list continuation. criteria.new_objects_package: Create a new objects:: package with an objects::object_fault{layer, code} error, same 14-op owner-first shape as new_store_package, but named for the object/key domain language (objects, keys, digests) rather than the service-implementation word store. Same lane separation from s3::; the only difference is which domain word future readers must learn.

i17_session_token_shape.instructions: How should Can rows obtain the pinned session token that put/settleWrite/pending/get/delete/list/closeSession require? openSession returns SessionFacts WITHOUT the token; sessionTokenForTest is the sole readout and is explicitly test-only. Judge by which shape keeps the token opaque, keeps test-only machinery out of the stable surface where possible, and stays closest to the I13-16 token-with-facts wrapper precedent.
